title: Tournament of Champions
seo_title: Bass Pro Tournament of Champions, Springfield MO, Jan 2027
description: The Bass Pro Tournament of Champions is a sports event held at Great Southern Bank Arena, running from Thursday, January 14 to Saturday, January 16, 2027. It begins at 4:00 PM on January 14 and ends at 2:00 PM on January 16, at 901 S. National Ave. in Springfield, MO. Ticketing information will be announced soon.
